summary: Comprehensive testing of BillsEasyPay redesign completed. All 45 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend UI tests passed for all major flows including landing page, login, register, customer dashboard, bills management, payment plan (3 options with 8% buffer), payment methods CRUD, settings with tabs, and admin dashboard with financial overview charts, outstanding bills by period, and customer analytics with risk levels.

integration_issues.issue: Admin user is redirected to /dashboard instead of /admin after login. User can manually navigate to /admin and it works correctly.

action_items: Consider fixing admin login redirect to go directly to /admin instead of /dashboard (currently admin can access /admin via sidebar link)
critical_code_review_comments: New Swiss corporate design with Outfit/Manrope fonts implemented correctly
Payment Plan page correctly shows 3 options (weekly/fortnightly/monthly) with 8% safety buffer visualization
Payment Methods CRUD working for bank accounts and credit/debit cards
Admin dashboard with Recharts showing financial overview, outstanding by period bar chart, and money flow pie chart
Customer analytics showing risk levels (low/medium/high) based on wallet balance vs pending bills
All data-testid attributes properly implemented for testing
Sidebar navigation working on both customer and admin dashboards
seed_data_creation: Test user and admin user verified in MongoDB with test bills and payment methods
context_for_next_testing_agent: Major redesign testing complete. All 45 backend tests cover: auth, bills CRUD, wallet/transactions, DDR, provider connections, payment plan (calculate/select/current/simulate-deduction), payment methods CRUD, admin stats, admin financial-overview, admin outstanding-by-period, admin customer-analytics. Frontend tests verified: landing page, login, register, customer dashboard with stats/overdue alerts/upcoming bills, bills page with OCR upload, payment plan page with 3 options and buffer visualization, payment methods page with bank/card CRUD, settings page with tabs, admin dashboard with Recharts charts, admin outstanding bills grouped by period, admin customer analytics with risk levels.

mocked_apis.payment_gateway: Simulated deposits/payments - no real payment processing
mocked_apis.accurassi_api: Falls back to OCR since no credentials configured
